research_snapshot.reported_mechanism: Top Deals /en-us/shop/deals/dc with laptop/desktop category slugs. Public search results expose embedded JSON objects with offerid, productData.shopUrl, marketPrice, dellPrice, metrics.productid, stockstatus, position.
research_snapshot.reported_extraction: Parse actual captured embedded offer JSON if present; preserve offerid+configuration ID, stockstatus, dellPrice, marketPrice, canonical shopUrl. Check configurable variants against cart item selection.
